description: Beyond Nations' README visuals, shot with darkroom's command backend (https://github.com/Preponderous-Software/darkroom). Build first: dotnet build src/BeyondNations.Desktop -c Release. Then: darkroom shoot tools/capture/media.json, and darkroom gallery tools/capture/media.json --insert README.md to put each image at its <!-- darkroom:shot NAME --> marker. See docs/CONTRIBUTING.md.

defaults.comment: Every shot runs the game in darkroom's scratch {work_dir} (its imgui.ini and logs go there and are thrown away). XDG_DATA_HOME points the game's data folder into {out_dir}, so its screenshots (BeyondNations/Screenshots/screenshot_*.png) are the frames; @common splices the shared flags and each shot's argv+ adds its own.

shots.name: flyover
shots.comment: Seed 12 fifty minutes in (150000 ticks), the camera gliding from one nation's village across the border to its neighbour's. About two minutes under llvmpipe.
shots.caption: Seed 12 after 150,000 ticks (fifty minutes of game time), drawn by the game's own Strata renderer, nobody playing: one nation's village, the border, the next nation's village.
shots.alt: A flyover of seed 12 fifty minutes in: over one nation's village, its houses, fields, market stalls, trees and residents, then across the line where two nations' rings of border posts meet, to a neighbouring nation's village

shots.name: seasons
shots.comment: One run per season, {value} being the season. It makes no GIF of its own: its four frames are the tiles of seasons-grid below.
shots.caption: The same spot on seed 12 in each season.
shots.alt: The same spot on seed 12 in one season

shots.name: winter-forest
shots.comment: The forest-orbit GIF's stand of trees on seed 12 (docs/screenshots/tree-model), on the first day of winter: one slow circle, the UI hidden.
shots.caption: Winter on seed 12: snow on the ground and on every crown. A winter tree gives wood and saplings, never apples.
shots.alt: One slow circle round a stand of trees on seed 12 on the first day of winter: pale snow-covered ground, round, tiered and oval crowns white with snow on brown trunks, their shadows on the snow, under a clear blue sky

shots.name: seasons-grid
shots.caption: The same spot on seed 12 in spring, summer, autumn and winter.
shots.alt: Four views of the same spot on seed 12, captioned Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter: fresh green, deeper summer green, olive autumn ground with orange and brown crowns on the trees, then pale snow with frosted trees; in each the Season box above the player box says which season it is, how long until winter and what the land is good for

shots.name: settlement-town
shots.caption: A lived-in town and today's HUD.
shots.alt: The town of Southernland on day 1: a plaza with a well and banner, market stalls with nation-coloured awnings and crates, houses and trees, residents milling about; round the edges the HUD -- the era bar, the first objective, the chronicle, the first tip, the inventory, the command bar, the Season box and the player box

shots.name: two-settlements
shots.caption: The nation screen of a nation with two settlements.
shots.alt: The nations screen of Southernland: 9 members and 2 settlements, 2 of the 3 the era allows -- the Town of Southernland, home, and a new Camp of Southernland, each with its residents and where it lies -- and what a third costs

shots.name: members-tab
shots.caption: The Members tab: every member, their loyalty, and the heir.
shots.alt: The Members tab: the people of Blackburg, three members, the heir Ella Wood marked in gold, each member's loyalty and traits, and how the heir is chosen

shots.name: laws-heir
shots.caption: The Laws tab: who your heir is, when old age comes, and Abdicate.
shots.alt: The Laws tab of Blackburg: changes take 30 seconds, Defence 3, Heir: Ella Wood, the longest sworn of your people, old age comes in about 40 minutes, an Abdicate button, then taxes, conscription, borders and rationing with a button for each setting

shots.name: market-panel
shots.comment: No flag opens the market panel, so click-shot.sh clicks it open the way a player does: Trade at Market on the command bar, the Stone button, then Sell, and grabs the window once state.json lists the panel. The points are the 1280x720 layout's.
shots.caption: The market panel: pick a good, see where it sells best and what you would make, and buy or sell a chosen quantity.
shots.alt: The market panel in the Village of Farmwood: one button per good (apples, wood, stone) with its buy and sell price and how many you carry, stone picked; buy at 21, sell at 20, the best price in reach is 34 at the Village of Blackburg, buy here and sell there for +13 a unit; -5, -1, +1, +5 and All; Buy 1 for 21 and Sell 1 for 20; the receipt Sold 1 stone to Tilly Davies for 21 coins and this visit's net +21

shots.name: settlement-screen
shots.caption: The settlement screen: one settlement's holder, people, buildings, stores and market, and who to give it to.
shots.alt: The settlement screen for the Camp of Southernland, 2 of 2 settlements of your nation: held by Charlie Wilson, given it by the leader; 0 of 8 residents, 22 paces north; no buildings yet, next a farm; funds 0 and an empty stockpile; 0 of 4 stalls and the prices; Prev and Next, a Give to picker with Give and Take Back, and Back

shots.name: winter-warning
shots.comment: Opens on the first day of autumn and runs 22000 ticks (from time 0.3 the next day starts at 21000) to the morning of the last day of autumn, when the warning fires.
shots.caption: The day before winter: the banner, the chronicle and the Season box say what the nation carries.
shots.alt: The night before winter in the town of Southernland: a banner says winter comes tomorrow and that 9 of the nation's 15 members are short of the food they want, the player's own hunger banner sits above it, and the Season box reads Autumn, day 2 of 2, Winter in 1 day, food 42 of 60 for winter
